title: Incorrect lock status check
detail: Twisted's Lock has a method `locked()`; accessing `self._export_lock.locked` returns the method object, which is truthy, so the condition is always true. This causes the lock to be acquired without awaiting and can lead to race conditions or deadlocks.

title: Indentation error
detail: The return statement is indented with 12 spaces instead of the 8 spaces used for the rest of the method body, causing an IndentationError and preventing the method from executing.
